review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares only two definitions: `eSub` and `basis`. `eSub` is the subtype-valued lift of `e r` into `CritChart.invariantsSubmodule`. `basis` is built with `Module.Basis.mk` from the linear-independence and span lemmas. Neither is a competing version of a Mathlib concept. They use the existing `Module.Basis`, `Submodule` and `LinearIndependent` APIs. The other declarations are theorems, such as `exists_cast_eq_of_pow_eq` (a fixed-point and polynomial-roots argument) and the `endAct` vanishing lemmas. Duplicated theorems are outside this rubric, so I did not assess them. I did not open the project's Definitions files, so I did not check whether `CritChart.invariantsSubmodule` or `endMatrix` duplicate Mathlib concepts. Those are defined outside this file and I treated them as given. I found no justified finding.
